title: Apéry-style Irrationality Proofs
short_description: Adapt Apéry's proof of the irrationality of $\zeta(3)$ to other constants.

title: The Arithmetic Kakeya Conjecture
short_description: Improve best-known upper bounds by constructing specific combinatorial objects.

title: Degree vs Sensitivity for Boolean Functions
short_description: Improve the exponent in the upper bound that degree has over sensitivity.

title: Explicit Deformations of Algebras
short_description: Find explicit deformations from curvilinear algebras to monomial algebras.

title: Inverse Galois
short_description: Find a polynomial whose Galois group is the Mathieu group $M_{23}$.

title: Surface with a High Number of Singularities
short_description: Present a KLT del Pezzo surface in characteristic 3 with more than 7 singular points.

title: Large Steiner Systems
short_description: Construct an $(n,q,r)$-Steiner system with $n > q > r > 5$, $r < 10$, and $n < 200$.

title: Prime Factorization
short_description: Improve the constant factor in the exponent of GNFS.

title: The $2$-adic Absolute Galois Group
short_description: Give a presentation for the absolute Galois group of the field of $2$-adic numbers as a profinite group.

title: Ramsey Numbers for Book Graphs
short_description: Prove a tight lower bound on Ramsey numbers for a class of off-diagonal book graphs.

title: A Ramsey-style Problem on Hypergraphs
short_description: Construct hypergraphs as large as possible that do not have a certain easy-to-check, difficult-to-find property.

title: Stretched Littlewood-Richardson Coefficients
short_description: Find partitions whose stretched LR-coefficients, when expressed as a polynomial, have a negative coefficient.

title: Symplectic Ball Packing
short_description: Find explicit embeddings of symplectic balls into a single target ball, taking up all but $\epsilon$ of the target ball's volume.

title: Unknotting Number = 1
short_description: Devise an algorithm that decides whether a knot has unknotting number equal to 1.
